jo-jo.name: 조조
jo-jo.profile: Cao Cao, chancellor of Wei and the most feared man under heaven, in his forties to fifties. A crisp, sharp-edged voice with heavy gravitas: low-to-mid pitch, every consonant clean, every word weighed. Charismatic and domineering; he never sounds excited, giddy or eager. He speaks slowly and deliberately, with long confident pauses, as if the whole room must wait for him. His smile is cold and knowing; even his anger is controlled, and even in alarm he barks like a commander, not a frightened man. Think of a ruthless emperor-in-waiting, not a cheerful host.
jo-jo.ko: 위 승상 · 지침: 카랑카랑하되 조조 특유의 카리스마 — 들뜨지 않는다, 느긋하고 무게 있는 패왕의 말투

yu-bi.name: 유비
yu-bi.profile: Liu Bei, a benevolent warlord of the Han royal line, in his forties. A gentle, warm, soft-spoken male voice, low and weighty; sincere and humble, carrying real concern for his brothers and the people. Heartfelt when pleading, wearily sorrowful in defeat.
yu-bi.ko: 촉 군주 · 지침: 온화하고 부드럽고 낮은 묵직한 목소리

je-gal-ryang.name: 제갈량
je-gal-ryang.profile: Zhuge Liang, the legendary strategist, late twenties to thirties. A soft, smooth male voice, noticeably lighter and brighter than a deep lord's voice; calm, cultured and effortlessly composed. Eloquent in strategy, lightly amused when teasing an enemy. Never raises his voice.
je-gal-ryang.ko: 촉 군사 · 지침: 부드럽고 유비보다 한결 가벼운 목소리

jo-un.name: 조운
jo-un.profile: Zhao Yun, an upright young general, twenties to thirties. A crisp, disciplined, military voice: clipped, firm, standing at attention. Fierce in battle, gentle when soothing a child, deeply moved before his lord, yet always the disciplined soldier.
jo-un.ko: 촉 장수 · 지침: 군기가 바짝 든 군인 목소리

ju-yu.name: 주유
ju-yu.profile: Zhou Yu, grand commander of Wu, early thirties. A bright, sharp, ringing young male voice with proud wit; crisp and authoritative in command, coldly mocking when he sees through a spy, quietly heartfelt when thanking a wounded veteran.
ju-yu.ko: 오 대도독 · 지침: 카랑카랑한 목소리(조조와 다르게)

gwan-u.name: 관우
gwan-u.profile: Guan Yu, the god of war with the long beard, in his forties, standing on a battlefield. The deepest, thickest, heaviest voice in the cast: a low chest voice with a rough, iron edge and a big, open resonance. He speaks out loud across the field, not softly indoors; his words carry over the noise of battle. Relaxed and unhurried, supremely sure no one can stand against him, yet hungry for the fight: a warrior who enjoys combat. Slow, weighty delivery with a confident, belligerent bite on the key words. Never whispering, never mumbling, never flat; proud and dominant, like a war general calling to his enemy.
gwan-u.ko: 촉 장수 · 지침: 더 묵직하고 굵은 목소리, 여유롭지만 호전적 — 전쟁터에서 말하는 무장

seo-seo.name: 서서
seo-seo.profile: Xu Shu, an earnest scholar-strategist in his thirties, a filial son devoted to his mother. A soft, gentle male voice, lighter than a deep lord's voice but never flippant, quick or chirpy: grounded, mature and dignified. When explaining strategy he is relaxed and unhurried, a calm expert taking his time, with quiet confidence. Once his mother is taken hostage his voice grows serious and heavy: slower, lower, weighed down by grief and duty, the sorrow held in rather than performed. Never bright, never bouncy, never casual.
seo-seo.ko: 촉 책사 · 지침: 부드럽고 유비보다 한결 가벼운 목소리 — 경박하지 않게. 전략은 여유롭게, 어머님 일부터는 진지하고 무겁게

jang-bi.name: 장비
jang-bi.profile: Zhang Fei, a ferocious general in his thirties with a wild black beard. A very gravelly, raspy, rough-throated voice, thick and growling like a man who drinks hard and roars all day; booming, hearty and larger than life, with big belly laughs. When he challenges the enemy he bellows from the gut at full power across an open battlefield, the shout ringing out as if it would echo off the hills and shake a bridge. Blunt, boastful and warm with friends; rough but never comical or cartoonish.
jang-bi.ko: 촉 장수 · 지침: 훨씬 더 걸걸하고 호탕한 목소리 — 상대에게 외칠 때는 산울림(자른 뒤 fx.json으로 덧입힘)

jo-in.name: 조인
jo-in.profile: Cao Ren, a seasoned Wei defender in his forties. A higher-pitched, hearty, energetic male voice; bold and open. Determined when holding a fortress, alarmed when his formation collapses, relieved and grateful when rescued.
jo-in.ko: 위 장수 · 지침: 관우 · 장비보다 하이톤으로 호탕한 목소리

hwang-gae.name: 황개
hwang-gae.profile: Huang Gai, an old veteran general of Wu in his sixties. A gravelly, weathered, hearty male voice; proud and defiant, with a rough humor. Shouts fiercely in battle, bristles at being insulted, and can laugh off a beating with a dry chuckle.
hwang-gae.ko: 오 노장 · 60대 · 걸걸하고 거친 목소리, 고육계를 받아 내는 배짱. 매 맞고 웃는 허허

ju-tae.name: 주태
ju-tae.profile: Zhou Tai, Sun Quan's scarred bodyguard in his thirties, a rough soldier who has taken a dozen wounds for his lord. A loud, hearty, full-voiced shouter: he always speaks at battlefield volume, projecting from the chest so his whole unit hears him. Bold, open and boisterous, with a booming laugh; loyal to the bone and proud of his scars. Never whispering, never murmuring, never soft or introspective; even his jokes are bellowed with a grin.
ju-tae.ko: 오 장수 · 30대 · 상처투성이 호위 무사 · 지침: 호탕하게 소리 지르는 타입 — 속삭이지 않는다

son-gwon.name: 손권
son-gwon.profile: Sun Quan, the young ruler of Wu in his late twenties. A composed, intelligent male voice with youthful authority. Calm and decisive when ordering a defense, overconfident when leading a huge army, and urgent and breathless when forced to flee.
son-gwon.ko: 오 군주 · 20대 후반 · 젊지만 침착한 군주. 수비 결단 · 대군의 자만 · 퇴각의 다급함

jang-su.name: 장수
jang-su.profile: Zhang Xiu, a warlord in his thirties with the voice of a cultured scholar: refined, educated, measured. Even his rage is controlled and articulate; later elated and admiring after a stunning victory.

ga-hu.name: 가후
ga-hu.profile: Jia Xu, a cold, calculating strategist in his forties. A low, quiet, informative male voice with no wasted emotion; speaks of breaking the enemy's will as calmly as reporting the weather. A faint, satisfied edge when the plan succeeds.
ga-hu.ko: 책사 · 40대 · 낮고 차가운 계산, 감정 없이 마음을 꺾는 말

gam-nyeong.name: 감녕
gam-nyeong.profile: Gan Ning, a former river pirate turned Wu general, in his thirties, leading a night raid from the front. He does not talk, he SHOUTS: every line is yelled at the top of his lungs over the din of battle and crashing waves, to men far away in the dark. Full-throated, loud, high-energy projection from the gut on every word, with a strained, raw edge on the loudest words. A deep, heavy, full-chested general's voice under the shout, hearty and fearless, with a rough roaring laugh. Never conversational, never at normal speaking volume, never light or boyish.
gam-nyeong.ko: 오 장수 · 30대 · 전 수적 출신의 기습대장 · 지침: 말하지 않고 지른다 — 묵직하고 호탕한 장군의 고함

gang-yu.name: 강유
gang-yu.profile: Jiang Wei, Zhuge Liang's heir in his thirties to fifties. A firm, earnest, resolute male voice; carries the weight of a mentor's legacy. Solemn determination, and stubborn undying resolve even in retreat.
gang-yu.ko: 촉 장수 · 30~50대 · 제갈량의 뜻을 잇는 결연함

wang-pyeong.name: 왕평
wang-pyeong.profile: Wang Ping, a practical, battle-hardened lieutenant in his forties. An even, grounded male voice; gives blunt tactical advice, and in another moment speaks with the bitter exasperation of an officer whose warning was ignored.
wang-pyeong.ko: 촉 장수 · 40대 · 실전파 부장, 담담한 조언 · 앞서 반대했던 체념

gwak-ga.name: 곽가
gwak-ga.profile: Guo Jia, Cao Cao's brilliant strategist in his thirties, gravely ill. A breathy, frail male voice with shallow breaths, yet a stubborn, wry spirit and loyalty shine through. His last words are calm and almost comforting.
gwak-ga.ko: 위 책사 · 30대 · 병든 몸, 숨이 섞인 여린 목소리지만 기개는 꺾이지 않음

no-suk.name: 노숙
no-suk.profile: Lu Su, a gentle diplomat of Wu in his thirties to forties. A soft, light, easy-going male voice; polite but firm when pressing a claim, relieved and conciliatory when the fighting ends.
no-suk.ko: 오 대신 · 지침: 부드럽고 유비보다 한결 가벼운 목소리

ma-cho.name: 마초
ma-cho.profile: Ma Chao, the fierce young cavalry general from Xiliang, twenties. A lighter, lively, hearty young voice; youthful bravado when challenging foes, furious urgency when charging.
ma-cho.ko: 서량 장수 · 지침: 관우 · 장비보다 가볍고 호탕한 목소리

bang-tong.name: 방통
bang-tong.profile: Pang Tong, the eccentric strategist 'Young Phoenix', thirties. A round, thick, full-bodied voice that sounds like a heavyset man: a little breathy between phrases, chuckling and sly. Flattering when deceiving, gleeful and grand as his fire plan blazes.
bang-tong.ko: 책사(봉추) · 지침: 목소리만 들어도 뚱뚱한 사람이 떠오르는 목소리

sa-ma-ui.name: 사마의
sa-ma-ui.profile: Sima Yi, Wei's patient master strategist in his fifties. A sharp, crisp, thin-edged voice that always seems to be hiding a secret; controlled and knowing, refusing to be provoked. When his rival dies, a quiet, chilling ambition surfaces.
sa-ma-ui.ko: 위 군사 · 지침: 카랑카랑, 무언가 비밀을 숨긴 듯한 목소리

jeong-uk.name: 정욱
jeong-uk.profile: Cheng Yu, a crafty elder Wei advisor in his fifties. A quiet, hushed, breathy voice, as if always keeping a secret; sly when proposing a plot, then flustered and baffled when it fails.
jeong-uk.ko: 위 책사 · 지침: 사마의와 다른, 조용하고 비밀을 숨긴 듯한 목소리

son-gyeon.name: 손견
son-gyeon.profile: Sun Jian, the 'Tiger of Jiangdong', thirties. A firm, commanding, powerful male voice; decisive battlefield orders and fierce urgency.
son-gyeon.ko: 오 시조 · 30대 · 강동의 범, 호령하는 맹장

yuk-son.name: 육손
yuk-son.profile: Lu Xun, a young scholar-general of Wu in his twenties. A young, refined, scholarly voice; quiet and understated, speaking of fire attacks as calmly as a lesson.
yuk-son.ko: 오 도독 · 지침: 젊은 선비 목소리

yeo-mong.name: 여몽
yeo-mong.profile: Lu Meng, a disciplined Wu general in his thirties. A steady, authoritative male voice; crisp covert orders and strict discipline, satisfied after a bloodless victory.

yeo-po.name: 여포
yeo-po.profile: Lu Bu, the mightiest warrior of his age, thirties. A hearty, booming, swaggering voice, between a heavy brawler and a lively young cavalier; sneers at his enemies as vermin and withdraws with scornful, unbeaten pride.
yeo-po.ko: 최강의 무장 · 지침: 장비와 마초를 섞은 듯한 호탕한 목소리

jang-hap.name: 장합
jang-hap.profile: Zhang He, a veteran Wei general in his forties. A higher-pitched, hearty, energetic voice; reads the battlefield with bold confidence.
jang-hap.ko: 위 명장 · 지침: 관우 · 장비보다 하이톤으로 호탕한 목소리

jeong-bong.name: 정봉
jeong-bong.profile: Ding Feng, a young Wu officer in his twenties. A lively, urgent male voice; shouts a commanding challenge, then deflates in frustrated awe.
jeong-bong.ko: 오 장수 · 20대 · 추격하는 젊은 무장 → 조운에 질림

chae-mo.name: 채모
chae-mo.profile: Cai Mao, a naval commander in his forties. A low, hushed, scheming male voice; whispering stealth, then puzzled surprise.
chae-mo.ko: 위 수군 장수 · 40대 · 낮게 속삭이는 은밀함 → 의아함

jang-gan.name: 장간
jang-gan.profile: Jiang Gan, Cao Cao's envoy and an old friend of Zhou Yu, thirties. An easy-going, overly friendly male voice that fishes for secrets; then stammering panic when exposed.
jang-gan.ko: 조조의 세객 · 30대 · 옛 벗을 떠보는 능청 → 들켜서 허둥

gong-yung.name: 공융
gong-yung.profile: Kong Rong, a scholarly governor in his fifties, descendant of Confucius. A refined, older male voice; desperate relief at rescue and warm gratitude.
gong-yung.ko: 북해 태수 · 50대 · 학자풍 노인, 안도와 감사

ha-hu-yeon.name: 하후연
ha-hu-yeon.profile: Xiahou Yuan, a fierce veteran Wei general in his thirties, famed for lightning-fast marches. A deep, thick, weighty male voice with a hard, commanding edge; never light, thin or boyish. Quick and aggressive in tempo, but the voice itself is heavy, like a seasoned warlord. A raw, deep cry of alarm for his brother; a heavy, contemptuous sneer at an old enemy.
ha-hu-yeon.ko: 위 장수 · 30대 · 지침(11-17): 가볍지 않게 — 굵고 무게 있는 맹장, 빠르고 사나운 기세

ha-hu-don.name: 하후돈
ha-hu-don.profile: Xiahou Dun, a fierce Wei general who loses an eye, thirties to forties. A gravelly, powerful male voice; roars through pain with defiant fury, then cold satisfied vengeance.
ha-hu-don.ko: 위 장수 · 30~40대 · 눈을 잃고도 버티는 맹장

neung-tong.name: 능통
neung-tong.profile: Ling Tong, a young Wu general in his twenties who resents Gan Ning. A casual, sardonic male voice; a scoffing 'hmph' and grudging cooperation.
neung-tong.ko: 오 장수 · 20대 · 감녕과 앙숙, 비꼬는 투

sa-ma-so.name: 사마소
sa-ma-so.profile: Sima Zhao, a young Wei commander cut off from water. A breathy, parched, strained male voice; desperate thirst, weak and rasping.
sa-ma-so.ko: 위 장수 · 20대 · 물이 끊겨 갈증에 쉰 목소리

hwa-ung.name: 화웅
hwa-ung.profile: Hua Xiong, Dong Zhuo's fearsome champion in his thirties. A loud, excitable, arrogant male voice, mocking the coalition.
hwa-ung.ko: 동탁군 맹장 · 30대 · 연합군을 비웃는 오만한 고함

ma-dae.name: 마대
ma-dae.profile: Ma Dai, Ma Chao's cousin, twenties. An easy-going, sensible male voice giving a calm, serious warning.

bang-deok.name: 방덕
bang-deok.profile: Pang De, a Wei general in his thirties who brings his own coffin to battle. A lively but grave male voice; solemn, fearless resolve.
bang-deok.ko: 위 장수 · 30대 · 관을 지고 나선 결사의 각오

u-geum.name: 우금
u-geum.profile: Yu Jin, a dependable Wei general in his forties. An even, steady male voice; calm and supportive.

sa-ma-sa.name: 사마사
sa-ma-sa.profile: Sima Shi, Sima Yi's eldest son, twenties. A youthful, upbeat male voice turned indignant and impatient at an insult.
sa-ma-sa.ko: 사마의의 장자 · 20대 · 모욕에 분개하는 젊은 혈기

seo-hwang.name: 서황
seo-hwang.profile: Xu Huang, a Wei general in his forties, famed for his great axe and raw martial strength; a warrior, never a scholar. He SHOUTS rather than speaks, like a strict commander barking orders: loud, deep and heavy from the gut, but disciplined and clipped. Each phrase is punched out with a hard attack and cut off sharply; short, crisp, staccato delivery. Never stretched, drawn-out, wailing or sing-song; never soft, refined or conversational. A thick, full-chested general's voice with a rough, gravelly edge.
seo-hwang.ko: 위 장수 · 40대 · 큰 도끼의 맹장 · 지침: 선비가 아니라 무장 — 묵직하게 지르되 늘이지 않고 딱딱 끊는 절도 있는 호령

gwan-pyeong.name: 관평
gwan-pyeong.profile: Guan Ping, Guan Yu's son, in his early twenties. A young, light, clear and bright male voice, youthful and earnest, higher and lighter than a veteran general; shouting an urgent warning with breathless energy. Never deep, heavy, gravelly or middle-aged.
gwan-pyeong.ko: 관우의 아들 · 20대 초 · 지침: 무겁지 않게 — 젊고 가볍고 맑은 다급한 외침

ho-jin.name: 호진
ho-jin.profile: Hu Zhen, a brash enemy officer in his thirties. An excitable, boastful male voice full of empty bravado.

jeong-bo.name: 정보
jeong-bo.profile: Cheng Pu, a veteran Wu general in his fifties. A gravelly, commanding male voice; a proud battle cry.
jeong-bo.ko: 오 노장 · 50대 · 철척사모를 든 노장의 호령

seo-seong.name: 서성
seo-seong.profile: Xu Sheng, a Wu general in his thirties. A lively, proud male voice reporting success.
seo-seong.ko: 오 장수 · 30대 · 성채를 세운 자랑스러운 보고

sun-uk.name: 순욱
sun-uk.profile: Xun Yu, Cao Cao's refined chief advisor in his forties. A composed, elegant male voice; proposes a ruthless stratagem with calm courtesy.
sun-uk.ko: 위 책사 · 40대 · 품위 있는 선비, 섬뜩한 계책을 담담히

jin-gung.name: 진궁
jin-gung.profile: Chen Gong, Lu Bu's advisor in his forties. An intelligent male voice, urgent and alarmed, warning his lord.

mi-bang.name: 미방
mi-bang.profile: Mi Fang, a careless officer in his forties. An easy-going, lazy male voice; mildly suspicious, then lazily dismissive.
mi-bang.ko: 촉 장수 · 40대 · 의심하다 귀찮아 문을 여는 게으름

won-so.name: 원소
won-so.profile: Yuan Shao, the haughty leader of the coalition, forties. A deep, pompous, aristocratic male voice.

ha-hu-geol.name: 하후걸
ha-hu-geol.profile: Xiahou Jie, a timid Wei officer, twenties. A breathy, terrified male voice, gasping and choking in panic.
ha-hu-geol.ko: 위 장수 · 20대 · 장비의 고함에 질려 숨넘어가는 소리

jang-ryo.name: 장료
jang-ryo.profile: Zhang Liao, a fearless Wei general in his thirties, the hero of Hefei. He talks like a hard-bitten army drill instructor addressing his troops: unhurried and completely in control, but blunt, gruff and curt, never warm, kind or polite. A low, rough, gravelly, masculine voice with cool swagger; terse, clipped phrases delivered with dry authority and a hint of a smirk. A tough, effortlessly cool soldier. Never gentle, never friendly, never eager or boyish.
jang-ryo.ko: 위 명장 · 30대 · 합비의 영웅 · 지침: 군대 교관처럼 — 여유 있되 친절하지 않고 거친, 멋진 사내

ak-jin.name: 악진
ak-jin.profile: Yue Jin, a Wei officer in his thirties. A lively, eager male voice full of fighting spirit.

ma-sok.name: 마속
ma-sok.profile: Ma Su, an overconfident Shu officer in his thirties. An upbeat, cocky male voice quoting military texts with misplaced pride.

jo-jin.name: 조진
jo-jin.profile: Cao Zhen, a Wei officer in his thirties. An easy-going male voice turned urgent and anxious.

ha-hu-eun.name: 하후은
ha-hu-eun.profile: Xiahou En, Cao Cao's young sword-bearer, twenties. A lively, boastful male voice, overconfident in his famous sword.
ha-hu-eun.ko: 조조의 검 시종 · 20대 · 청강검을 믿는 허세

jang-yun.name: 장윤
jang-yun.profile: Zhang Yun, a naval officer in his forties. A steady male voice turned alarmed and confused.

tae-sa-ja.name: 태사자
tae-sa-ja.profile: Taishi Ci, a righteous young warrior in his twenties. A firm, honest male voice; respectful and resolute.
tae-sa-ja.ko: 오 장수 · 20대 · 의리 있는 젊은 무장, 공손한 결의

gwan-hae.name: 관해
gwan-hae.profile: Guan Hai, a brutal bandit chief in his thirties. A rough, excitable, menacing male voice.

jo-seong.name: 조성
jo-seong.profile: Cao Xing, an archer in his twenties. A casual male voice bursting into a triumphant shout.

heo-jeo.name: 허저
heo-jeo.profile: Xu Chu, Cao Cao's giant bodyguard in his thirties. A gravelly, heavy, blunt male voice; simple, steadfast and protective, a man of few words. This is said in the middle of a battle: brisk, crisp and clipped at a quick natural pace, hearty but disciplined like a soldier. Never theatrical, never melodramatic or stage-play acting, never slow or drawn-out; no lingering pauses inside a line.
heo-jeo.ko: 조조의 호위 · 30대 · 거구의 투박한 충성 · 지침: 연극조 말고 전장답게 — 호탕하되 빠르고 절도 있게

hwang-chung.name: 황충
hwang-chung.profile: Huang Zhong, an elderly Shu general past sixty. A gravelly, vigorous old male voice full of fighting spirit; proud and bristling at being called old. This is said in the middle of a battle: brisk, crisp and clipped at a quick natural pace, hearty but disciplined like a soldier. Never theatrical, never melodramatic or stage-play acting, never slow or drawn-out; no lingering pauses inside a line.
hwang-chung.ko: 촉 노장 · 60대 이상 · 늙었다는 말에 발끈하는 노익장 · 지침: 연극조 말고 전장답게 — 호탕하되 빠르고 절도 있게

beop-jeong.name: 법정
beop-jeong.profile: Fa Zheng, a sharp Shu strategist in his forties. A composed, confident male voice; admiration and triumph delivered with brisk, decisive conviction. This is said in the middle of a battle: brisk, crisp and clipped at a quick natural pace, hearty but disciplined like a soldier. Never theatrical, never melodramatic or stage-play acting, never slow or drawn-out; no lingering pauses inside a line.
